title: Stormlog Studio bootstrap v1
description: POST /api/v1/admin/bootstrap, admin token only: a fresh launch URL for stormlog studio url (design §2.4, §5.4). The bootstrap token travels in the URL fragment, which no request line, log or Referer sees.

url.description: http://<loopback host>:<port>/#/auth?t=<bootstrap token>, with the requested route after it.
